issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristic silently mislabels any 4+ character acronym (VPC, S3, RDS-like cases) and lacks tests.
issues.detail: The rule 'length <= 3 means acronym' is a guess, not an invariant. 'iam' (3) maps to IAM, but 'logs' (4) becomes 'Logs', and 'aws' is fine while 'azure' would not be. The previous explicit CATEGORY_LABELS table was provably correct for the known input set; replacing it with a heuristic without unit tests over the actual category ID list trades verified correctness for unverified cleverness. State the invariant: 'for every ID returned by the metadata endpoint, label(id) equals X'. Then test it.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes Math.max over data on every row render, turning O(n) into O(n^2).
issues.detail: maxValue = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value)) is now inside the .map() callback that iterates each item. For n bars this is n calls of an n-pass reduction. Hoist maxValue (and total) above the .map() so each renders the loop body in O(1). The category set is small today, but the invariant 'one pass over data per render' is cheap to preserve and the constant matters as the chart is reused.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER now has two keys mapping to value 4 (Informational and Info) with no comment on which is canonical.
issues.detail: Adding 'Info: 4' alongside 'Informational: 4' creates a silent alias. If any consumer iterates Object.entries(SEVERITY_ORDER) expecting a bijection from rank to name, it will see two names for rank 4. State the invariant in a comment: 'Info is an alias accepted from upstream payloads; Informational is the display name.' Otherwise the next reader will not know which is which.

issues.description: CustomDot isFaded logic does not state its termination/identity invariant when selectedPoint.category collides.
issues.detail: isSelected compares selectedPoint?.category === currentCategory, where currentCategory = payload.name || payload.category. If two radar points ever share a display name (the label formatter could now produce one if two raw IDs collapse), both render as 'selected' and neither fades. Compare on categoryId, which the data carries and is guaranteed unique by the API, rather than the human-readable label.

issues.description: CategorySelector treats empty string and 'all' as equivalent sentinels without documenting why both exist.
issues.detail: handleValueChange branches on value === '' || value === 'all'. The Select only ever emits 'all' or a real categoryId, so the empty-string branch is dead code or defensive padding against an undocumented case. Either delete the '' check or write a one-line comment stating which upstream caller can emit it. Dead branches accumulate; literate code names them.

review.summary: The refactor is mostly a cosmetic and structural cleanup, but it trades one piece of provably correct code (an explicit CATEGORY_LABELS table) for a heuristic in lib/categories.ts whose invariant ('IDs <=3 chars are acronyms') is unstated and untested against the real category set. The horizontal bar chart now does Math.max inside a per-row render, an O(n^2) regression where O(n) is trivially achievable by hoisting. Smaller items: a silent severity alias (Info/Informational both = 4) with no comment, a label-based identity check in the radar dot that should use categoryId, and a dead empty-string branch in CategorySelector. UNDER-AUDITED overall; rigor would be restored by a test enumerating expected labels for every category ID the backend can return.
